freeze.policy: Author-defined intent; coequal conflicting titles and unsupported documents are other. No inference used to author probes. Baseline is original native rules type; tagger agreement and Python port parity are audited. C1/C2 imported unchanged. Single-page type only, no voting, no candidate tuning or original rescoring.
freeze.metrics: Unchanged type_row/summarize exact, recovered/regressed and false-bank accounting. Every row retained; missing native output fails and yields null, not other credit. Report every prediction, class/group totals, confusion matrices, non-type invariants. Separate designed counterexamples, never pooled with previous DEV scores.
freeze.integration_gate: Any new regression, non-other unsupported/ambiguous outcome, or failure on a supported class blocks integration recommendation. Passing would still not establish real-world/OCR/security generalization.
